grant_statement: GPU 已释放；批准 AUTH-REQUEST-V0-S0-WP-S0-46-01，按 authorization-correction-16.request.json 的完整范围执行一次，并在终态后自动过期。
required_preconditions: project owner explicitly reports that the unknown GPU workload was normally closed or released
executed harness file SHA-256 equals the Git blob at harness_candidate_sha
Windows-native and WSL GPU samples agree within 128 MiB and used memory is <=4096 MiB
no target ComfyUI/Ollama process and no listener on 8191/11434
OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD is observed true and owned PID has no non-loopback connection for >=10 seconds and >=5 samples
mandatory_stops: candidate, harness, model or sample mismatch
pre-service identity, GPU, process or port gate failure
no-cloud or non-loopback network gate failure
GPU memory reaches or exceeds 23552 MiB
public prompt/history or semantic Oracle failure
per-call unload, final cleanup or target-integrity gap
forbidden: downloads, upgrades or permanent target configuration writes
product, harness, contract, Oracle, timeout or threshold changes
reuse or extension of any prior authorization
evidence_minimization: persist only target process matches, aggregate process counts, authorized listener owner IDs and redacted diagnostics; never persist the complete process table or unrelated command lines
cleanup: unload every started model call, require terminal /api/ps empty, stop run-owned PIDs, prove ports empty, remove run temp and verify target integrity
expires_when: one terminal WP-S0-46 receipt is generated or either media attempt budget is consumed
